environment.storage: Local NVMe for all biological inputs, references, outputs and scratch

method: Paired-end integrated trimming, alignment, TranscriptVB quantification, and optional in-process Y removal. B02 paper timing uses the integrated interval; the complete driver interval is separately reported. Paper quantification uses the accepted Salmon 1.10.3 automatic-library-type control, which detected ISR, with standard Pearson and Spearman correlations over all shared genes or transcripts, including zeros. The historical unstranded-control regression check is retained only as additional diagnostic evidence. The corrected 1.9.5 tag was built with the accepted benchmark recipe and one SHA256-identified binary was used everywhere. Scientific arguments, input formats, reference content, hash caches, and caller settings were preserved. Each arm ran once on a quiet host, with fresh outputs and a fatal cold-cache preflight. All input, reference, output, temporary and spill locations were checked against the intended storage. Comparator outputs and times were retained; no comparator was rerun. Completion, executed-command identity, the 1.30 maximum timing ratio, and canonical correlation/cell-call tolerances were checked before scheduling the next arm. Byte equality is a recorded diagnostic rather than an acceptance gate.
limitations: One timed execution per arm, not a replicated distribution.
Retained comparator outputs are comparison evidence rather than ground truth.
Wall times depend on the recorded CPU, storage and cache conditions.

B01 timed processing exited successfully, but its outer instrumentation driver failed during post-run bookkeeping after an in-session shell-file edit. The original GNU time, completed output and wrapper summary were preserved and independently validated; only completion bookkeeping was repaired. No duplicate biological execution occurred. An exact device-wide end-counter delta is unavailable for B01; its GNU time accounting is complete.
